# Audio fixtures

One-second 440 Hz sine tones used by the core tests and the optional GUI
playback smoke test. Each format carries the same signal, so a decoder that
opens the file but emits silence is still caught.

They are synthetic: generated by this project from FFmpeg's `sine` source and
dedicated to the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). No attribution is
required. (MIT is a software licence and does not apply to audio recordings.)

## Regenerating

```bash
cd tests/fixtures/media
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a pcm_s16le tone.wav
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 32k tone.mp3
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a libvorbis -q:a 1 tone.ogg
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a flac tone.flac
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 16000 -c:a aac -b:a 32k -f mp4 tone.m4a
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=440:duration=1" -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a libopus -b:a 32k tone.opus
```

## Checksums

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `tone.wav` | `b2165fcfc9898da2854b95c31014d5466f942debc288af7e5d99506f155138fe` |
| `tone.mp3` | `ea88b625642df385dd2d4c8d32bdf889c3291e116740ad5df68ec63fabee3b99` |
| `tone.ogg` | `9d9da7a56434a3a139cb2661543bf23c2974f28eb366ad8269ce4ce6de177b5b` |
| `tone.flac` | `caa6068d840802fdea4ba9a00839a4b5eb5aebba77aefd86ef858630b008d14a` |
| `tone.m4a` | `1585d25b0585a9631c0340ded3bbfd619b51408cffaecf5d5d48ab680445cc58` |
| `tone.opus` | `c3ecef3450afdc4457ea9b647931ede486399803d1c8a6bdf8861b8d944cc197` |

Decoding depends on the codecs installed at runtime: WAV, FLAC, Vorbis and Opus
come from GStreamer's base and good plugin sets, while MP3 and AAC need
`gstreamer1.0-libav`. The playback smoke test reports a skip when a decoder is
missing instead of failing.
